title: ASML reports €11.7 billion total net sales and €5.0 billion net income in Q3 2026

passages.note: Quarterly system sales table and outlook footnote 2. Q3 sales include 113 new and eight used lithography tools across all types. An outlook footnote gives plans to increase both low-NA EUV and DUV immersion capacity. Aggregate sales do not give fab output, installation dates, or High-NA shipment counts.
